sentences.text: The illustration for a sanctioned loan amount of ₹20,000 at 15% with a monthly EPI for 24 instalments shows an EMI of ₹970 per month.
The earlier KFS 2024 table that also showed ₹20,000 and 24 monthly instalments is no longer in force, because it was withdrawn with effect from 2025-11-28.
The in-force illustration also explains that the detailed repayment schedule rounds the instalment to ₹970 from ₹969.73.
